basic_info.description: Just steps from the vibrant energy of Union Street in Cow Hollow, this Victorian home offers the best of city living with an unexpected sense of privacy and tranquility.  Tucked away down a private drive, it feels like a hidden sanctuary, a rare retreat in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods.    The primary residence features three bedrooms, two full bathrooms, soaring ceilings, and sunlit oak hardwood floors.  The inviting living and dining areas flow into a well-appointed kitchen with custom cabinetry and stainless steel appliances.  Below, a fully permitted one-bedroom in-law unit with a separate entrance, full kitchen, and courtyard access offers flexibility.    What truly sets this home apart is its peaceful front courtyard set back from the main street.  It offers a central location but is removed from the city's hustle, providing a rare blend of urban convenience and private retreat.  The home offers one car parking space in the garage and one in the driveway.    This is an extraordinary opportunity for those seeking charm, flexibility, and a quiet haven in the heart of it all.
